mapper.select: SELECT id, assignment_code, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, pool_id, pool_type, initiation_id, initiation_name, opportunity_id, status, allocation, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, billable, daily_hours, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_resource_assignment WHERE assignment_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, assignment_code, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, pool_id, pool_type, initiation_id, initiation_name, opportunity_id, status, allocation, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, billable, daily_hours, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_resource_assignment WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, assignment_code, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, pool_id, pool_type, initiation_id, initiation_name, opportunity_id, status, allocation, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, billable, daily_hours, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_resource_assignment WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, assignment_code, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, pool_id, pool_type, initiation_id, initiation_name, opportunity_id, status, allocation, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, billable, daily_hours, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_resource_assignment WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, assignment_code, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, pool_id, pool_type, initiation_id, initiation_name, opportunity_id, status, allocation, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, billable, daily_hours, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_resource_assignment WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status IN ('RESERVED','ACTIVE','TRANSFERRING') AND deleted = 0 AND (planned_start_date IS NULL OR planned_start_date <= #{date}) AND (planned_end_date IS NULL OR planned_end_date >= #{date})
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pmis_resource_assignment WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status IN ('RESERVED','ACTIVE','TRANSFERRING') AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pmis_resource_assignment WHERE pool_id = #{poolId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','TRANSFERRING') AND deleted = 0
